name: hyphen-is-not-a-subject-character
why: Everyone arrives from routing keys, where 'order-created' is idiomatic, and assumes subjects work the same way. They do not: the grammar is letters, digits, underscores and dots. Refused rather than rewritten to an underscore, because that rewrite is another invention four SDKs would have to share, and because a subject silently differing from what the publisher wrote is worse than a clear refusal at publish time.
